policies.sentence: Students must not use AI to write or generate code for assignments.
Students must not submit AI-generated code, text or other work as part of graded submissions.
Students must not ask AI to solve problems, give answers or complete homework and assignments for them.
Students must not copy or look up solutions or code from online sources, including AI.
Students must not use AI to debug, fix, improve or translate their code.
Students must write the code and work they submit themselves, without AI help.
Students should treat AI as an assistant or consultant, not an author or subcontractor.
Students may use AI to generate code under stated conditions, such as documentation or their own algorithm.
Submitting AI-generated work is academic dishonesty or a violation of the honor code.
Students must not use AI tools other than the course's own.
